input_fields.name: failed_file_absolute_path
input_fields.description: Absolute path to one failed run-owned file.

input_fields.name: ownership_and_failure_record
input_fields.description: Run ownership, failure reference, exclusions, and cleanup reason.

result_fields.name: cleanup_result
result_fields.description: Target path, pre-delete hash/size, removal status, and preserved failure reference.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when ownership, file type, or association is unproven.

procedure: Resolve absolute path without following unsafe reparse target and verify ownership/exclusions.
Record size/SHA-256, remove exactly that one file through the host adapter, and verify absence.
Return cleanup_result with failure reference and pre-delete identity; do not remove parents/siblings.
Return needs_manual_review without deletion when any check is unresolved.
rejection_rules: Do not delete because a filename merely looks failed.
